_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score is coiled inside the Complacency band with 30d BTC near flat and F&G mid-range; no breaker (ETF revival or fear flush) is present, so the statistically honest call is hold the rung.
next_move.brains_agree: Analyst explicitly HOLD/Complacency; narrative is descriptive only (L/S high) and does not push a phase shift — mild agreement on non-breakout
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC 30d stays inside roughly ±3% and fear_greed holds 47-54 with funding near flat
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed >62 on renewed ETF inflows, or fear_greed <39 with funding flipping negative on a fast sell
